situation: I've emailed a local bookstore owner, Ruth, twice about hosting a reading of my novel. No reply in 3 weeks. Want to send one last email.
reply: Hi Ruth, last nudge from me on the reading. I'll assume the timing isn't right and stop filling your inbox, but if a slot opens up in the new year, I'd still love to do it at Chapter House. Thanks, Nadia
note: Third and final bump: close the loop yourself, and don't send a fourth.

situation: 周六组织同学聚餐，今天必须跟饭店订包间，老王还没回我来不来。
reply: 老王，周六的包间我今晚8点前要跟饭店确认，你来不来？来不来都行，回个字就好。
note: 把回复变得很小，截止时间是为了订位，不是为了催人。

situation: I followed up with my contractor about the kitchen quote and he snapped back 'I saw it, I've been slammed.' I still need it before I can book anyone.
reply: Totally understand. No rush from me before the 20th; after that I'll need to start lining someone up, so a rough date for the quote would help whenever you get a sec.
note: Don't defend the nudge. Take the answer, give room, and state the real planning date once.

situation: My former professor, Dr. Hayes, agreed on Sept 8 to write me a recommendation for a master's program. The deadline is Oct 15 and the portal still shows it as not submitted. I already resent the link once on Sept 15.
reply:
Hi Dr. Hayes,
I know the start of term is hectic. A quick note on the recommendation for the Urban Planning MA at Northfield: the portal still shows it as pending, and the deadline is Thursday 15 October. I've pasted the upload link below so you don't have to dig for it. If a short list of the projects I did in your seminar would save you time, I can send it today.
Thank you again,
Sofia
note: Assume busy, restate the thing and the date in one line, and make doing it easier than postponing it. Don't ask whether they're still willing.
